description: Accelerate the low-rank paths dominant cost (brief-40 profiler finding: FP32-SIMT CholeskyQR2 solves + Vd lift, not the orth gate) by running the CQR2 Gram matrix V^T V and the Vd lift GEMMs in TF32 tensor-core precision instead of FP32-SIMT (~8-10x faster on B200). CholeskyQR2s second reorthogonalization pass self-corrects the reduced first-pass precision, so the returned factors stay gate-clean. Affects the low-rank routed shapes 8/10 and the mixed peel. Pure torch.

t1: dominant power-step CQR2 Gram + Vd lift -> plain TF32 (knobs _LR_DOM_GRAM_MODE/_LR_VD_LIFT_MODE). MASS FALLBACK: geomean 34318->52386. Dominant Qd is ill-conditioned (concentrated spectrum kappa 1e3-1e4); TF32 Gram ~3e-4/op breaks orthonormality above orth gate, 2-pass CQR2 does NOT self-correct -> low-rank shapes fall to full cuSOLVER (s3 81034->248124, s4 50416->154028, s6 132638->241163, s8 93153->249856, s10 104900->194442, s12 34012->97051). Confirms brief-16 t1 on this parent. 39/39 PASS.

t2: Vd lift -> plain TF32 ONLY (dominant Gram restored to FP32). STILL mass fallback: geomean 34318->45194. Qd,G individually orthonormal but TF32's ~3e-4/op on the n*k@k*k product breaks assembled V=[Vd,Vc] orth above 80*n*eps gate (~4.9e-3 n=512) -> s3 81034->251786, s6 132638->243455, s8 93153->253874, s10 104900->197744 fall to full cuSOLVER. shape4 61262 mild, shape12 33608 ~clean. Confirms brief-7 t7. 39/39 PASS.

t3: dominant CQR2 Gram + Vd lift -> 3xTF32 (Ozaki hi+lo split, FP32-accurate ~6e-6, NO fallback). geomean 34318->34698 (+1.1% regress). Most low-rank shapes IMPROVE (s4 50416->48730, s6 132638->126645, s8 93153->91573, s10 104900->102242, s12 34012->33706) but shape3 (dense512 k=352 b640) REGRESSES 81034->104820: 3xTF32 split overhead (int32 mask+3 bmms+2 adds on B*n*k) expensive at b640/n=512 in the CQR2 Gram loop -> drags geomean. Confirms brief-16 t4/t9. Next: Vd-lift-only + per-shape scoping. 39/39 PASS.

t4: Vd lift -> 3xTF32 ONLY (dominant Gram FP32, FP32-accurate no fallback). geomean ~35034 (2 runs, indiv shape noise spikes: shape10 228671 run1 / shape9 60857 run2). Target shapes at parent: s3 81041 s6 132598 s8 93299 s10 104486 -- NO improvement from Vd-lift 3xTF32 alone (small one-shot GEMM, split overhead offsets tensor-core saving, confirms brief-16 t9). So t3's shape4/8/10 gains came from the DOMINANT Gram 3xTF32, not the Vd lift. 39/39 PASS.

t5: dominant CQR2 Gram -> 3xTF32 ONLY (Vd lift FP32). geomean ~34705. CLEAN mechanism: dominant-Gram 3xTF32 helps s4 50416->49235, s6 132638->126315, s8 93153->91396, s10 104900->102808, s12 34012->33594 but REGRESSES shape3 (dense512 k=352 b640) 81034->104554. Profile (brief-44-trial-5-shape3-0726056) shows a PARTIAL cuSOLVER FALLBACK newly appearing under 3xTF32: sytrd4_cta 7.6M ns + 886 gemvx + 256 symv (syevd internals) absent in FP32 parent. shape3 at eigen-residual floor (k=352), so 3xTF32's ~6e-6 extra error tips borderline matrices' orth over 80*n*eps gate. Lever for 4/6/8/10/12 but must be scoped off shape3. 39/39 PASS. Profile: brief-44-trial-5-shape3-0726056442a4029cc8d3bc61627c748d592a329d.nsys-rep

t6: per-pass dominant CQR2 Gram (pass1 FP32, pass2 TF32) via new gram_mode tuple support. Hypothesis: CQR2 self-corrects conditioning so pass-2 Gram on well-conditioned Q1 tolerates plain TF32. MASS FALLBACK anyway: geomean 34318->44974 (s3 81034->123878, s4 50416->117656, s6 132638->182964, s8 93153->115755, s10 104900->156106, s12 34012->90772). Plain TF32 forbidden anywhere in dominant CQR2; only FP32-accurate 3xTF32 survives. 39/39 PASS.

BEST HEAD = d6ce9b524f7cf2b1a6d60088a61965347433dbdf (branch autocuda/optimize/2026-06-30-18-52-36-eigh/brief-44). geomean ~34015us (clean runs 34003/34015/33975/34023/34045/34052/34012/33991/34081/33838; median ~34015) vs parent 34318 = a STABLE ~0.8-0.9% win. 39/39 VALIDATE PASS every trial. PER-SHAPE (target shapes, best config vs parent): shape3 dense512 PRESERVED 81030 (fp32, 0 fallback -- protected); shape4 dense1024 50416->48977 (-2.9%); shape6 mixed512 132638->126096 (-4.9%); shape8 rankdef512 93153->91466 (-1.8%); shape10 nearrank1024 104900->102730 (-2.1%); shape12 lapgeom1024 34012->33445 (-1.7%). shape7 mixed1024 unchanged (not peeled). Every low-rank routed shape + the mixed peel improved; NO shape regressed.

WHAT I BUILT (all in submission.py, pure torch, no nvcc): a per-shape dominant-CQR2-Gram precision router _lr_dom_gram_mode_for(n,k) + a _MIXED_PEEL_DOM_GRAM_MODE knob, threaded through _lowrank_eigh/_eigh_lowrank_safe as dom_gram_mode/vd_lift_mode; a symmetric-aware 3xTF32 Gram _gram_3xtf32_sym (2 bmms vs 3, exploits Gram cross-term transpose symmetry); per-pass gram_mode tuple support in _lr_cholesky_qr2; a _lr_lift_gemm helper for the Vd lift. FINAL LIVE CONFIG: dominant Gram = 3xTF32 (FP32-accurate Ozaki) for n=1024 (shapes 4/10/12, k in {384,608,768}) + n=512/k>=384 (shape8 rankdef) + mixed-peel dense(k=352)/psd(k=256); FP32 on the zero-margin n=512 dense512 route (shape3). Vd lift stays FP32.

CQR2 FALLBACK RATE: UNCHANGED on the target shapes. 3xTF32 is FP32-accurate so it does not grow the fallback set: shape8 profile shows the SAME 12 sytrd4_gpu(n=512) fallback instances as the parent; shape3 kept on FP32 preserves its 0-fallback parent behavior. Verified by profile (no new syevd kernels appear where 3xTF32 is applied).

KEY MEASURED NEGATIVES (refuting the brief's literal TF32 hypothesis, so you can steer):
(a) PLAIN TF32 on the dominant CQR2 Gram (both passes) -> MASS FALLBACK, geomean 52386 (t1). The dominant subspace Qd is ill-conditioned (concentrated spectrum, kappa 1e3-1e4); TF32's ~3e-4/op breaks orthonormality over the 80*n*eps gate and the 2-pass CQR2 does NOT self-correct it. Confirms brief-16 t1.
(b) PLAIN TF32 on the Vd lift ALONE -> STILL mass fallback (45194, t2): the assembled V=[Vd,Vc] orth exceeds the gate even though Qd,G are individually orthonormal.
(c) PER-PASS (pass1 FP32, pass2 TF32) -> STILL mass fallback (44974, t6): the shapes sit at the orth-gate FLOOR (spectral tail -> subspace only approx-invariant), so even pass-2's TF32 rounding on the well-conditioned Q1 tips the final orth over the gate. Plain TF32 cannot appear ANYWHERE in the dominant CQR2.
(d) 3xTF32 (FP32-accurate) UN-SCOPED on the dominant Gram -> +1.1% REGRESS (34698, t3/t5): helps 4/6/8/10/12 but shape3 (dense512, k=352, at the eigen-residual floor) PARTIALLY FALLS BACK because 3xTF32's ~6e-6 residual tips its zero-margin matrices over the gate (profile brief-44-trial-5-shape3 shows new sytrd4_cta+886 gemvx+laed that the FP32 parent lacks). SCOPING shape3 off 3xTF32 (t7) recovers the win.
(e) 3xTF32 on the Vd lift -> net-NEUTRAL (t4/t8): the n*k@k*k lift is too small to amortize the Ozaki split (confirms brief-16 t9), so it stays FP32.

WHY THE WIN IS CAPPED AT ~0.8%: profiles (brief-44-trial-7-shape8, -trial-11-shape10, -trial-10-shape6) show that after the dominant Gram moves to tensor cores, the low-rank path is dominated by (1) the INNER reduced-block eigh -- mega_eigh_med_split_k (38% shape8) / mega_eigh_clust_split_k (59% shape10) -- brief-11/35 territory, NOT the Gram; and (2) batch_trsm_left_kernel (14.5% shape8, 5.4% shape10), the CQR2 TRIANGULAR SOLVE, which is intrinsic FP32 and outside my brief's Gram/Vd-lift scope. The dominant Gram was only ~6-7% FP32-SIMT; halving it to tensor cores yields ~2% per shape, ~0.8% geomean.

STILL OPEN (surface, do not close): (1) The CQR2 TRSM (batch_trsm_left, the single biggest remaining OUTER FP32 op, 14.5% shape8) resisted brief-16's every precision trick -- a structurally different orthonormalizer (fused Newton-Schulz keeping the ill-conditioned dominant subspace orthonormal, or a batched-trsm that engages more SMs) would attack the bigger lever; OFF this brief's Gram/Vd-lift scope. (2) The A@Qd / A@Omega SUBSPACE-ITERATION matvecs (cutlass3x simt_sgemm _nnn, ~6% shape8) are still FP32-SIMT and NOT the CQR2 Gram; CQR2 re-orthonormalizes Qd afterward so reduced precision there MIGHT be tolerable -- untested, a distinct lever from this brief. (3) NO BF16x9 emulation is reachable via torch 2.12 (matmul.fp32_precision accepts only tf32/ieee/none), so the ~3x-FP32 cuBLAS emulation the env mentions can't be toggled in pure torch -- would need a cuBLAS compute-type call (nvcc/C++). (4) A symmetric batched SYRK for the Gram (compute only the triangle in ONE launch) is not exposed by torch; a custom CUDA syrk would halve the Gram flops again (nvcc, off this pure-torch brief). (5) The scoped-3xTF32 change is ORTHOGONAL to the inner-solve/gate work and stacks cleanly onto the current best f8e44f9d1; it never regresses any shape, so it is safe to graft. Recommend keeping HEAD d6ce9b5 as a small banked win and pointing a follow-up at the trsm (the real remaining lever).
